summary.one_liner: A proof-of-concept that packages the OpenClaw personal AI assistant to run inside a Cloudflare Sandbox container on Cloudflare Workers.
summary.what_it_does: Deploys the OpenClaw (formerly Moltbot/Clawdbot) gateway and Control UI to a Cloudflare Sandbox container, so the assistant runs as an always-on hosted service. It supports connecting to Telegram, Discord, and Slack via bot tokens, and uses device pairing with an admin UI at /_admin/ to approve new devices. Optional R2 storage backs up config, paired devices, and conversation history so they survive container restarts. It can route model calls through Cloudflare AI Gateway (Anthropic, OpenAI, Workers AI, Groq and others) or use a direct Anthropic or OpenAI key. It also includes a Chrome DevTools Protocol shim for headless browser automation, with built-in screenshot and video skills.
use_cases: Self-host a personal AI assistant on Cloudflare
Run an always-on AI chat bot connected to Telegram, Discord, or Slack
Route LLM API calls through Cloudflare AI Gateway
Headless browser automation, screenshots, and scraping from an agent
Deploy an AI agent to Cloudflare Containers without managing servers
how_to_run: export MOLTBOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN=$(openssl rand -hex 32) and store it with npx wrangler secret put MOLTBOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN
Enable Cloudflare Access on the workers.dev domain and set CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN and CF_ACCESS_AUD, then redeploy
Pair your device via /_admin/ before using the Control UI
notable: Runs OpenClaw in a managed Cloudflare Sandbox container rather than on a self-hosted machine
Device pairing requires explicit admin approval for each new device, on top of a gateway token
Optional R2 backup/restore keeps paired devices and chat history across restarts
Includes a CDP shim and built-in cloudflare-browser skill for screenshots and video capture
Cost guide with a standard-1 instance estimate of about $34.50/month, plus SANDBOX_SLEEP_AFTER to cut idle costs
caveats: Explicitly experimental and unsupported; may break without notice
Requires the Workers Paid plan ($5/month) plus roughly $26-30/month in container compute if run 24/7; the README estimates about $34.50/month total
Cold starts take 1-2 minutes; wrangler dev has known WebSocket limitations, so full functionality needs deployment to Cloudflare
